skill.summary: Coach a founder on engineering warm introductions to specific VCs / partners — building a target list (15-30 firms, ranked by stage / sector / partner-fit, n...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of vc-warm-intro-coach skill.
- Guides founders step-by-step on warm VC introduction strategy: target list building, introducer mapping, and high-quality forwardable emails.
- Emphasizes partner-fit over firm brand, and prioritizes high-conviction introducers.
- Covers etiquette, double-opt-in requests, tracking intro outcomes, and alternatives when intros don’t land.
- Designed to trigger on common fundraising and VC outreach phrases.
